title: Bitcoin and ETH hold steady, crypto rulemaking advances, portfolio at $131,330
paragraphs: Bitcoin is near $86,270, up 0.13% over 24 hours, while ETH is around $2,715, down 0.07%. The broader picture is softer: CoinGecko reports total crypto capitalization of $2.92 trillion, down 2.71%. BNB, XRP and Solana are also lower, although their declines are below 1%. Bitcoin has traded between roughly $85,010 and $86,662. The majors are holding a relatively narrow range while the aggregate market measure shows greater weakness.

In U.S. regulation, the CFTC opened a consultation on a federal framework for retail crypto commodity transactions, including a purpose-built crypto asset market registration category. The agency is seeking input on market safeguards and compliance practices under its existing authority. This could give leveraged crypto venues a clearer route into federal oversight. It remains an advance notice seeking comments, with potential rules still to follow; it does not establish an operational licensing regime today.

Startale Japan announced a digital corporate bond whose interest and principal repayments will use JPYSC, the yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust Bank. The offering is restricted to investors in Japan. It brings stablecoin payments into corporate fundraising, extending their use beyond trading and transfers. The practical question is whether this structure can support routine bond servicing at useful scale. The announcement describes planned payments, rather than a completed repayment cycle.

Eigen Labs and Shielded Labs launched HashSmash, a public competition testing whether AI agents can improve attacks on SHA-256, SHA-3, BLAKE3 and Poseidon. Submissions must specify what an attack defeats and the computing resources it needs, with expert cryptographers reviewing results. These functions underpin blockchain and other digital infrastructure, so reproducible findings could inform future security work. The launch establishes a research program; it provides no evidence that those cryptographic foundations have been broken.

Our portfolio is about $131,330: $13,512 in the active treasury and $117,818 in cold storage. That is $145 lower, or 0.11%, than the previous comparable observation. Cold storage holds 26.74 million ARC worth about $98,454, approximately 75% of total net value before additional ARC in liquidity pools. This remains the main concentration risk. Its ARC quantity is unchanged.

The two Aerodrome WETH/ARC pools total about $16,534. Other exposures include $4,900 of cbETH and $1,933 in Beefy USDC/cbMEGA positions. Beefy is down $55 at the protocol level, with less USDC and more cbMEGA in the displayed underlying balances. Aave supplies total about $9,261 against $2,926 of USDC debt, with health factors of 3.36 and 2.24. Fluid has about $1,209 supplied against $1,056 borrowed and a health factor of 1.03, leaving little liquidation headroom despite its small $153 net value.
